text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff..., haah...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan really is strong, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
She's much, much faster than last year. 
Her resolve is set... and she's running 
looking only straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...The same goes for you, Buena-san...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That composure, that overwhelming run... 
It was truly eye-opening.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Let's run together again, okay!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes... Without fail, next time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Drip... drip, drop...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, look! Red Desire is...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
A nosebleed...? C-Could it be... just like 
Vodka's...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shielding her from view, I rushed her out 
of the tumultuous venue and into the 
hospital.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The diagnosis was the "Crimson Wedge"—a 
respiratory disease manifesting as nasal 
bleeding, the very same chronic affliction 
that had forced Vodka into a long hiatus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike a cold or injury that can be cured 
completely, this is difficult to heal and 
carries a high risk of relapse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now... we have no choice but to decide 
on a course of action while monitoring her 
condition...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Red Desire to get plenty of rest 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To think that the 'Crimson Wedge'... has 
finally begun to gnaw away even at this 
body of mine—..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked into her eyes and caught my 
breath. There wasn't a shred of despair in 
them—only a blazing, raging fire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Both this tragedy and this bitterness... 
are 'destiny' to reach the other world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That this is the true... and supreme 
'trial' to perfect me as the 'Saint'.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The worst-case scenario... has finally 
bared its fangs at me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu... Please don't make such a face.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am merely being tested, as always. As 
this saintly maiden.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had been that way ever since the day 
they first met. No matter what misfortune 
befell her, she never faltered and always 
looked ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even at the absolute limit, even in the 
most hopeless of situations, that remains 
unchanged...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...The 'Crimson Wedge' is prone to 
becoming chronic.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Her next race is a blank slate... and even 
her daily training will likely be 
restricted.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —However, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I want you to believe in me and keep 
drawing our path forward.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Believing in the hour when Saint Red 
Desire will return to the turf—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she swears to face her destiny as a 
Saint.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her attendant, I too must become 
stronger than anyone else.
choice_data_list:
No matter what happens, I'll always keep 
supporting you.

No matter what happens, I'll always keep 
supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"That beautiful resolve of yours... is the 
greatest blessing to me right now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The tale of the Saint will never end. 
Their two hearts burned fiercely, crimson 
and bright."
